pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū kokanade pāsāde sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍessanti seyyathāpi gihī kāmabhoginoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.6: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaghare chaḍḍethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.11: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍessanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.12: netaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.14.1: na sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.16: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk56:1.22: uddharitvā vā bhinditvā vā paṭiggahe vā nīharitvā chaḍḍeti
